purpose: Defines the graph-theoretical trajectory modeling, Tarjan SCC cycle loop detection, argument grounding scoring, and resolution monotonicity algorithms for Lumen.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-pattern: TrajectoryGraph, TrajectoryNode, TrajectoryEdge, TarjanCycleDetector, compute_grounding_score, and calculate_monotonicity.
non_goals: Raw token pricing or financial accounting (delegated to lumen-model).
Database persistence or query filtering (delegated to lumen-store).

api_surface.name: TrajectoryGraph
api_surface.signature: pub struct TrajectoryGraph { graph: petgraph::graph::DiGraph<TrajectoryNode, TrajectoryEdge> }; impl TrajectoryGraph { pub fn from_transcript(transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> Self; pub fn detect_cycles(&self) -> Vec<Vec<usize>>; pub fn calculate_monotonicity(&self) -> f32; pub fn compute_grounding_score(&self) -> f32; }
api_surface.description: Directed acyclic/cyclic graph representation of agent execution paths, tool dependencies, and state transitions.

api_surface.name: TarjanCycleDetector
api_surface.signature: pub struct TarjanCycleDetector; impl TarjanCycleDetector { pub fn find_scc_cycles(graph: &TrajectoryGraph) -> Vec<CycleAnomaly>; }
api_surface.description: Executes Tarjan's strongly connected components algorithm to find cyclic tool loops and redundant file exploration.

api_surface.name: calculate_monotonicity
api_surface.description: Computes the monotonicity coefficient M in [0.0, 1.0] measuring whether each turn moves monotonically closer to task resolution.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN a transcript contains 3 identical view_file invocations on the same path without interleaving mutations, THE SYSTEM SHALL identify a Tarjan SCC cyclic loop and emit a CycleAnomaly.
WHEN computing resolution monotonicity M on a linear pass transcript with zero backtracking, THE SYSTEM SHALL return M = 1.0.
WHEN an agent encounters compiler errors and corrects them on the next turn, THE SYSTEM SHALL compute Error Recovery Index R = 1.0.
WHEN compute_grounding_score is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL compute the ratio of tool argument values grounded in prior user or tool outputs versus hallucinated values.
IF a transcript has 0 or 1 turns, THE SYSTEM SHALL return monotonicity M = 1.0 and grounding score = 1.0 without dividing by zero.

reasoning: Establishes graph-theoretical trajectory modeling, Tarjan SCC cycle detection, and mathematical quality indicators.
